citation.title: A Biphasic Glucose Response during an Oral Glucose Tolerance Test Is Associated with Greater Plasma Insulin and GLP-1 Responses and a Reduction in 1-Hour Glucose but Does Not Relate to the Rate of Gastric Emptying in Healthy, Older Adults

reported.what: 1 h plasma glucose after 75 g OGTT, monophasic (n=22) vs biphasic (n=14) glucose-curve group, initial study; means with SEM

location.quote: the 1 h post-OGTT plasma glucose response was greater in the monophasic vs. biphasic group 9.5 ± 0.5 mmol/L vs. 8.0 ± 0.5 mmol/L (p = 0.04)

reported.what: gastric emptying (kcal/min and T50) by glucose-curve group, initial study
insulin secretion (insulinogenic index) by glucose-curve group, initial study

detail: Every number is reported only for two groups defined by the shape of their own OGTT glucose curve (monophasic against biphasic, a responder split that differs in age but is not told apart by sex, age or BMI alone), no pooled cohort value is printed, and neither group is a healthy reference (the cohort includes impaired glucose tolerance), so no arm can be written without asking the model for two different numbers from the same people.
